name: Usilosimapundu
body:
USILOSIMAPUNDU
CR 21

The mountain begins to move, revealing a thick-lipped, powerful maw. Trees and shrubs shudder and wave from its rocky back as it lurches to life with a deafening grinding sound.

XP 409,600
N Colossal magical beast (earth)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +41

DEFENSE

AC 37, touch 2, flat-footed 37 (+35 natural, –8 size)
hp 424 (32d10+248)
Fort +26, Ref +20, Will +18
DR 15/—; Immune critical hits and precision damage, mind-affecting, paralysis, petrification; Resist acid 10, cold 30, electricity 30, fire 30

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 slams +40 (3d8+16/19-20 plus push), bite +40 (6d6+16/19-20 plus grab)
Ranged rock +25 (4d8+24)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks earthquake (usable every 1d4 rounds), fast swallow, rock throwing (120 ft.), trample (2d8+24, DC 42), swallow whole (12d6 bludgeoning, AC 27, hp 42)

STATISTICS

Str 42, Dex 11, Con 26, Int 11, Wis 22, Cha 13
Base Atk +32; CMB +56 (+60 to grab); CMD 66 (70 against trip)
Feats Awesome Blow, Critical Focus, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Initiative, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Critical (slam), Improved Natural Attack (bite), Improved Natural Attack (slam), Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Lunge, Power Attack, Step Up, Toughness, Vital Strike
Skills Climb +35, Knowledge (geography) +16, Perception +41
Languages Common, Draconic, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Avalanche (Ex)

As a full-round action, an usilosimapundu can use its Awesome Blow combat maneuver against each Large or smaller creature in a 30-foot cone, dealing damage as its rock ranged attack.

Bashing Boulder (Ex)

When an usilosimapundu hits a creature with a hurled rock, the target is stunned 1 round (DC 42 Fort negates). A Large or smaller creature that fails its save is also knocked prone. The save DC is Strength-based.

Earthquake (Ex)

As a full-round action, an usilosimapundu can create an earthquake, as the spell, centered on any of its spaces or an adjacent space. It is subject to the effects itself.

Tremor Stomp (Ex)

A creature struck by both of an usilosimapundu’s slam attacks in the same round is knocked prone (DC 42 Reflex negates). The save DC is Strength-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any warm or temperate wilderness
Organization solitary
Treasure double

The usilosimapundu (female ugungqu-kubantwana) is a bumpy beast of inconceivable size. It has a broad mouth like a rhino or a tortoise, a scaly basalt-like body, and its back is covered with dirt, hill-like masses, and even vegetation. It has been compared to a living mountain. Although generally a restful and disinterested creature, an usilosimapundu is proud, territorial, and capable of great wrath. It sometimes demands tribute from nearby communities that annoy it or provoke its judgment or envy.

An usilosimapundu is of mythical size, creating sounds like a rockslide or laden wagon as it walks. Ordinary weapons are all but ineffective. It can swallow creatures whole and shake the very earth.

Despite being bestial in appearance, an usilosimapundu considers itself the sovereign ruler of its territory. It may have herds of cattle, tenants working its land, and servants and advisors. It may have a considerable hoard in its lair, often a huge cave or a crudely assembled manor.
